# Acorn

`acorn.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from `acorn@8.19.0`.
It is vendored for offline browser and Node use. The package is MIT licensed;
see `acorn.LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/tree/8.19.0/acorn
